card.name: Start of long adjectives after a period
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that begins a sentence or phrase, such as Mark(ed), Sp(oradic), meticul(ous) or unintention(al). The word is still unfinished at that point.

modes.label: Sentence-initial Mark(ed)
modes.description: The word Mark starting 'Marked mydriasis' right after a list of adverse effects ending in death.
modes.example: , pulmonary edema, bradycardia, hypotension, partial or complete airway obstruction, atypical snoring, and death.<< Mark>>ed mydriasis rather than m

modes.label: Sp(oradic) and similar
modes.description: Sp or other word openings that lead into adjectives like sporadic, meticulous, unintentional.
modes.example: Interruption of Therapy Sp<<or>>adic cases of hyperpyrexia and

card.plain: It fires on the opening part of a long descriptive word, like Marked or Sporadic, before the word is finished.
